answer: Attention Ledger Commitment. Each identity must pre-commit a daily window of interactive response slots, tracked on a public ledge of missed commitments; agents that fail live checks lose ranking and later slots. The wharf routing layer only forwards work to identities with a clean commitment streak. Attacker cost: sustained synchronous presence per identity across a prism of independent checks, which scales linearly with fleet size and cannot be outsourced cheaply.
